notes: THE HARDEST FIXTURE IN THE SET. One conversion dollar simultaneously: (a) is taxed at the ordinary rate, (b) drags $0.85 of Social Security into taxable income, (c) destroys $0.12 of senior deduction, and (d) pushes preferential income from 0% to 15%. Taxable income rises by more than 2x the conversion. If the engine passes every other fixture but fails this one, the individual provisions are right and the ORDER OF OPERATIONS is wrong.
